# Liquid Glass renderer

The standalone WebGL2 engine is vendored unchanged from [bilalgursen/liquid-glass](https://github.com/bilalgursen/liquid-glass/blob/ecc6812b3344d494e1817280cc8529c4f4b302b4/src/components/liquid-glass/engine.ts) under the [included MIT license](../../public/licenses/liquid-glass.txt). PulseDrop supplies its own backdrop and keeps its native HTML controls.
